- [EAA / WCAG 2.2 E-Commerce Accessibility & Checkout Fix Sprint](https://khoaphan.dev/services/#eaa-audit): 48-hour HTML, ARIA, form-label, and mobile checkout compliance remediation for Shopify, WooCommerce, and EU-facing stores under Directive (EU) 2019/882, backed by the live public scanner at https://apify.com/khoaphan/eaa-accessibility-auditor (`$65 – $145`).
- [Apify Actors, Lead Enrichment & Office Automation](https://khoaphan.dev/services/#business-automation): Custom Apify Store scrapers (https://apify.com/khoaphan/b2b-contact-auditor), exact-cent PDF invoice reconciliation to Google Sheets, competitor price/stock alerts, and idempotent payment webhook auto-fulfillment (`$65 – $240`).
- [Payment Webhook Idempotency & Smart Contract Audits](https://khoaphan.dev/services/#security-audits): Deterministic `HTTP 402 / x402` nonce guards, Stripe/VietQR TOCTOU race audits, minor-unit integer accounting, and Clarity (`sBTC`) / Stellar Soroban (`wasm32v1-none`) / Solana Anchor smart contract verification.

- [Compliant Marketplace & CRM MCP Servers](https://khoaphan.dev/writing/compliant-marketplace-crm-mcp-architecture/): Why cookie-replay MCP bots trigger JA4/PerimeterX/Forter bans and how to build airlocked human-in-the-loop CRM MCPs.
- [Zero-Zombie MCP Servers: OS-Level Process Containment & Sub-210ms Reconnect](https://khoaphan.dev/writing/zero-zombie-mcp-servers/): Eliminating orphaned stdio/TCP MCP child processes via Windows Job Objects (`JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE`) and Linux cgroups.
- [Idempotent Webhook WAL & Minor-Unit Billing](https://khoaphan.dev/writing/idempotent-webhook-wal/): Preventing TOCTOU double-credits in payment webhooks using SQLite WAL unique constraints and integer minor units.
